models.label: deepseek-flash (serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)
models.notes: Exact match: the official 'MODEL VERSION' for the deepseek-flash API name is literally DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, so no fuzzy mapping is needed. Figures are PEAK (standard) list prices in CNY per 1M tokens from the official zh pricing page. Off-peak list price is exactly half: 1 / 0.02 / 4 CNY (peak windows are 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, Mon-Fri excluding Chinese public holidays). Official USD list price for the same tier: 0.30 miss / 0.006 hit / 1.20 output per 1M (off-peak 0.15 / 0.003 / 0.60), which implies the page uses 6.6667 CNY/USD for this tier.

models.label: deepseek-v4-pro (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813)
models.notes: PEAK list price in CNY. Off-peak is half: 4.5 / 0.15 / 13.5. Official USD list price: 1.32 / 0.044 / 3.96 per 1M (off-peak 0.66 / 0.022 / 1.98). Note the CNY and USD pages are not exactly consistent for this tier: they imply 6.818 CNY/USD, versus 6.667 for the Flash tier; prefer the CNY figure for a CNY-denominated calculator.

models.label: deepseek-flash
models.notes: Catch-all for any *flash* DeepSeek id. The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted and are billed at the Flash price (the underlying models are retired and routed to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), so mapping them here is officially correct rather than an assumption.

models.label: deepseek-flash (conservative default)
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: an unrecognised DeepSeek id is priced at the Flash tier, the cheapest current official tier. This deliberately under-states rather than over-states 'money saved'. deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner were discontinued on 2026-07-24 and are no longer on the price list.

models.label: GLM-5.3-FlashX
models.notes: Official CNY list price, 1M context. GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal is priced identically. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.30 / 0.085 / 1.05.

models.label: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.notes: Official CNY list price, 1M context, native multimodal. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.12 / 0.034 / 0.42. Cache storage is currently free ('限时免费'). This is the tier used for the local id GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3; the -EXL3 suffix is an EXL3/ExLlamaV3 GGUF-style quantisation tag and has no separate official price, so this is an ASSUMPTION (same model family, same nominal tier).

models.label: GLM-5.3
models.notes: Official CNY list price, flagship tier, 1M context, flat (no context-length tiering). USD equivalent at 6.67: 1.20 / 0.30 / 4.20. Must be matched AFTER the glm-5.3-flash / glm-5.3-flashx rows, because 'glm-5.3-flash' contains 'glm-5.3' as a substring.

models.label: GLM-5.2
models.notes: Official CNY list price (same numbers as GLM-5.3). USD equivalent at 6.67: 1.20 / 0.30 / 4.20.

models.label: GLM-5.1 (input < 32K tier)
models.notes: Official CNY list price for input length [0,32K). The >=32K tier is 8 / 2 / 28. A per-request calculator cannot know the input length, so the cheaper tier is used. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.90 / 0.195 / 3.60.

models.label: GLM-5-Turbo (input < 32K tier)
models.notes: Official CNY list price for input length [0,32K). The >=32K tier is 7 / 1.8 / 26. GLM-5V-Turbo (vision) is priced identically. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.75 / 0.18 / 3.30.

models.label: GLM-5 (input < 32K tier)
models.notes: Official CNY list price for input length [0,32K). The >=32K tier is 6 / 1.5 / 22. Must be matched after all glm-5.x rows. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.60 / 0.15 / 2.70.

models.label: GLM-4.7 (base tier: input < 32K, output < 0.2K)
models.notes: Official CNY list price. GLM-4.7 is billed in three buckets: [0,32K) in / <0.2K out = 2 / 0.4 / 8; [0,32K) in / >=0.2K out = 3 / 0.6 / 14; [32K,200K) = 4 / 0.8 / 16. The cheapest bucket is used here, so savings are under-stated for long outputs. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.30 / 0.06 / 1.20.

models.label: GLM-4.7 base tier (nearest successor to GLM-4.6)
models.notes: ASSUMPTION / fuzzy match: GLM-4.6 (text) no longer appears on the official price list; only GLM-4.6V (vision, 1 / 0.2 / 3 for [0,32K) input) is still listed. The 2 / 0.4 / 8 figures are the GLM-4.7 base-tier prices, chosen because GLM-4.7 is the priced successor in the same 4.6/4.7 line. If a local id is specifically GLM-4.6V, prefer that vision row instead (1 / 0.2 / 3 CNY).

models.label: GLM-4.5-Air (input < 32K, output < 0.2K)
models.notes: Official CNY list price. Other buckets: >=0.2K output 0.8 / 0.16 / 6; [32K,128K) 1.2 / 0.24 / 8. USD equivalent at 6.67: 0.12 / 0.024 / 0.30.

models.label: GLM-4.7 base tier (fallback for non-Air GLM-4.5)
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: base GLM-4.5 (non-Air) is not on the current official text price list, so the GLM-4.7 base tier is used. Must be matched after glm-4.5-air.

models.label: GLM-5 (input < 32K tier), conservative mid-tier default
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: an unrecognised GLM id falls back to the GLM-5 base tier rather than the flagship GLM-5.3, to avoid over-stating savings. Zhipu also publishes a Batch API discount (50% of standard) and currently-free cache storage, which this calculator ignores.

models.label: qwen3.8-27b
models.notes: Official Model Studio list price for the dense 27B vision-language model, Beijing region, retrieved 2026-11-11. Singapore (international) deployment is 0.5 input / 0.1 cache hit / 3 output / 0.625 explicit cache creation per 1M tokens, i.e. ~18% higher on input and ~77% higher on output. Explicit cache creation is a separate billed line and is what the plugin uses for cache-write tokens; implicit cache writes bill as ordinary cache-miss input.

models.label: qwen3.8-max (international deployment)
models.notes: Official USD list price per 1M tokens, 0<Token<=1M, no tiering. qwen3.7-max is 2.5 / 7.5; legacy qwen-max (China mainland) is 0.345 / 1.377. Cache-hit price is not in this table: the 上下文缓存 doc bills explicit-cache hits at 10% of the standard input price (cache creation at 125%), so 0.20 is the derivable hit price for qwen3.8-max.

models.label: qwen3.8-flash (international deployment)
models.notes: Official USD list price. qwen3.7-flash is tiered by input length: 0.030 / 0.130 for <=32K, 0.100 / 0.400 for 32K-256K, 0.200 / 0.800 for 256K-1M. Cache hits are billed at 10% of input per the cache doc, so 0.015 is the derivable hit price for qwen3.8-flash.

models.label: qwen3.8-flash (conservative default)
models.notes: ASSUMPTION: unrecognised Qwen ids fall back to the cheapest current Flash tier. Prices are region-dependent on Bailian (Singapore/Beijing/HK/EU/US differ); these are the international-deployment figures, which are the ones matching an OpenAI-compatible endpoint outside China.

models.label: Kimi K3 series (prices NOT confirmed)
models.notes: UNCONFIRMED: the official pricing page renders its price tables client-side, and every text/markdown variant of the page (including /docs/pricing/chat.md and llms-full.txt) contains an empty table, so no number could be read from the official source on 2026-11-11. What IS officially stated: K3 series has 1,048,576-token context and flat pay-as-you-go pricing with separate cache-write (5min / 1h TTL), cache-hit and cache-miss input rates plus output; Batch API is 60% of standard price; K2 series retires end of December 2026. Do not display a saving figure for Kimi until the numbers are filled in; do not copy a third-party figure into an official-pricing table.
